title: Margherita Flatbread
ingredients: 1 each Flatbread Dough|3 fl oz Tomato Sauce|3 oz Mozzarella Cheese Shredded|1 oz Fresh Basil Leaves|1 Tbsp Olive Oil
cook_steps: Stretch dough to 12x6 inches and dock with docking tool.|Spread tomato sauce over dough leaving 1/2 inch border.|Sprinkle mozzarella evenly over sauce.|Bake in 500-degree oven for 8 minutes until crust is golden brown.|Remove from oven and top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.|Cut in half lengthwise then make 4 cuts widthwise for 10 even slices.
plate_steps: Slide flatbread onto a rectangle plate.

title: Cheese Flatbread
ingredients: 1 each Flatbread Dough|3 fl oz Tomato Sauce|4 oz Mozzarella Cheese Shredded|1 tsp Dried Italian Herbs
cook_steps: Stretch dough to 12x6 inches and dock with docking tool.|Spread tomato sauce over dough leaving 1/2 inch border.|Sprinkle mozzarella evenly over sauce.|Sprinkle dried herbs over cheese.|Bake in 500-degree oven for 8 minutes until crust is golden brown.|Cut in half lengthwise then make 4 cuts widthwise for 10 even slices.
plate_steps: Slide flatbread onto a rectangle plate.

title: Veggie Flatbread
ingredients: 1 each Flatbread Dough|3 fl oz Tomato Sauce|3 oz Mozzarella Cheese Shredded|2 oz Roasted Bell Peppers|1 oz Sliced Mushrooms|1 oz Sliced Red Onion
cook_steps: Stretch dough to 12x6 inches and dock with docking tool.|Spread tomato sauce over dough leaving 1/2 inch border.|Sprinkle half the mozzarella evenly over sauce.|Distribute bell peppers, mushrooms, and onion evenly over dough.|Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over toppings.|Bake in 500-degree oven for 8 minutes until crust is golden brown.|Cut in half lengthwise then make 4 cuts widthwise for 10 even slices.
plate_steps: Slide flatbread onto a rectangle plate.

title: Garden Salad
ingredients: 6 oz Romaine Lettuce Chopped|2 Tbsp Parmesan Cheese Shredded|1/2 cup Croutons|2 fl oz House Dressing
plate_steps: Place romaine in center of a chilled large round plate piling as high as possible.|Place croutons evenly over salad.|Sprinkle parmesan cheese over entire salad.|Place a ramekin of house dressing at 3 o'clock.

title: Cold Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 10 oz Cooked Rice Noodles|1 cup Red Cabbage Shredded|2 fl oz Ginger Dressing|2 oz Pickled Vegetables|1 Tbsp Sesame Seeds|1 Tbsp Cilantro Chopped
cook_steps: Place rice noodles in microwave for 45 seconds.|Combine noodles, cabbage, and dressing in a mixing bowl and toss gently until evenly coated.
plate_steps: Place dressed noodles and cabbage in center of a chilled large bowl, piling as high as possible.|Top with pickled vegetables.|Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over everything.|Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Chocolate Brownie Sundae
ingredients: 1 each Chocolate Brownie|3 oz Vanilla Ice Cream|1 fl oz Chocolate Sauce
cook_steps: Place brownie in microwave and heat for 45 seconds.
plate_steps: Place warm brownie on a small plate.|Place ice cream scoop in the center of the brownie.|Drizzle chocolate sauce over ice cream and brownie.

title: Pasta Marinara
ingredients: 8 oz Cooked Cavatappi Pasta|4 fl oz Marinara Sauce|2 Tbsp Parmesan Cheese Shredded
cook_steps: Place pasta in a microwavable container and microwave for 45 seconds.|Add heated pasta to a saute pan over medium heat, add marinara sauce, and toss well to incorporate.
plate_steps: Place pasta into a large bowl.|Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top of pasta.

title: Butter Pasta
ingredients: 8 oz Cooked Cavatappi Pasta|1 oz Unsalted Butter|2 Tbsp Parmesan Cheese Shredded|to taste Salt and Black Pepper
cook_steps: Place pasta in a pasta basket and cook in 200-degree water for 1 minute.|Add heated pasta to a saute pan over medium heat, add butter, and toss well to incorporate.|Season with salt and pepper to taste.
plate_steps: Place buttered pasta into a large bowl.|Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top of pasta.

title: Pan-Seared Fish Plate
ingredients: 6 oz Fish Fillet|2 Tbsp Oil Blend|8 oz Mashed Potatoes|4 oz Blanched Broccolini|2 fl oz Lemon Butter Sauce|to taste Salt and Pepper|1 each Lemon Wedge
cook_steps: Season fish fillet with salt and pepper on both sides.|Heat oil on flat top and add fish flesh side down, cook for 3 minutes then flip.|Cook until internal temperature reaches 135 degrees.|While fish cooks, place broccolini with oil and salt on flat top and cook until hot.|Heat lemon butter sauce in a small saute pan until warmed through.
plate_steps: Scoop mashed potatoes into center of the plate.|Place broccolini on the left of potatoes from 11 o'clock to 7 o'clock.|Lay fish flesh side up on top of potatoes from 7 o'clock to 3 o'clock.|Ladle sauce around the potatoes and broccolini.|Garnish with lemon wedge at 3 o'clock.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 each Sourdough Bread Slices|2 oz Cheddar Cheese Sliced|1 Tbsp Unsalted Butter|6 oz French Fries
cook_steps: Butter each slice of sourdough and place on 350-degree flat top butter side down.|Place cheddar cheese on each slice.|While sandwich is cooking, place fries in 350-degree preheated fryer and cook for 2 1/2 minutes.|Place second slice of bread on top and cook until cheese is fully melted.|Cut in half diagonally.
plate_steps: Place sandwich at 12 o'clock on the plate.|Place fries at 6 o'clock.|Place ramekin of ketchup at 3 o'clock.

title: Classic Club Sandwich
ingredients: 3 each White Bread Slices Toasted|4 oz Turkey Breast Sliced|2 each Bacon Strips Cooked|2 each Lettuce Leaves|2 each Tomato Slices|1 fl oz Mayonnaise|6 oz French Fries
cook_steps: Toast bread slices on 350-degree flat top until golden brown.|While bread toasts, place fries in 350-degree preheated fryer and cook for 2 1/2 minutes.|Spread mayonnaise on each toasted bread slice.
plate_steps: Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato between toasted bread slices.|Secure with picks and cut diagonally into quarters.|Place sandwich at 3 o'clock on the plate.|Place fries at 9 o'clock.|Place ramekin of ketchup in the center.

title: Crispy Shrimp Bowl
ingredients: 12 oz Cooked Rice|12 each Breaded Shrimp|2 oz Pickled Vegetables|2 fl oz Sriracha Aioli|1 fl oz Soy Glaze|1 Tbsp Sesame Seeds|1 Tbsp Cilantro Chopped
cook_steps: Place breaded shrimp in 350-degree preheated fryer and cook for 2 1/2 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 145 degrees.|While shrimp cook, place rice in microwave for 1 minute.|Toss fried shrimp in 1 fl oz sriracha aioli until evenly coated.
plate_steps: Place heated rice in center of a large round bowl, piling as high as possible.|Drizzle soy glaze over rice.|Drizzle remaining sriracha aioli over rice.|Place shrimp at 9 o'clock.|Place pickled vegetables at 12 o'clock.|Place cilantro in center of bowl.|Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over all ingredients.

title: Fish & Chips
ingredients: 6 oz Battered Fish Fillet|8 oz French Fries|2 fl oz Tartar Sauce|2 oz Coleslaw|1 each Lemon Wedge
cook_steps: Place battered fish in 350-degree preheated fryer and cook for 4 minutes until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 145 degrees.|Place fries in 350-degree preheated fryer and cook for 2 1/2 minutes until golden brown.|Remove fish and fries and allow to drain briefly.
plate_steps: Place fries on the left side of a large oval plate.|Place fish on the right side of the plate.|Place coleslaw in a small ramekin at the top of the plate.|Place tartar sauce in a small ramekin in the center.|Place lemon wedge at 3 o'clock.
